title: Avneel Singh — Developer Portfolio
summary: A premium minimal dark portfolio for Avneel Singh, a Computer Science postgraduate focused on software engineering, web development, and practical AI/ML.
prompt: Create a premium minimal dark portfolio for Avneel Singh, an M.Tech Computer Science student at IIT Bhubaneswar. Use a charcoal canvas, high-contrast typography, a restrained lime accent, generous spacing, responsive project cards, accessible navigation, subtle transitions, reduced-motion support, and sections for selected work, education, skills, and contact. Keep all academic details and project claims factual. Use a clear project filter and a contact flow that explains it opens an email draft rather than claiming to send mail directly.
